req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject player creation requests with an invalid id type by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This is a validation requirement, and the test suite should cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robust validation. The positive case will test a valid integer id, the negative case will test a non-integer id, and the boundary case will test the smallest valid integer id.

tests.name: test_create_player_with_valid_id
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The players database is pre-loaded with test data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid integer id.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_create_player_with_invalid_id_type
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The players database is pre-loaded with test data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a non-integer id.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating validation failure.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": "twenty-seven",
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text
